Title: Re: V:TES Hall of Fame adds new members

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Fernanda Nunes and Fernando Marinho join the V:TES Hall of Fame with five tournament wins each.

V:TES Hall of Fame

To enter the V:TES Hall of Fame, a player has to win a minimum of five tournaments, and those tournaments must have had their results posted on the official V:EKN Player's Forum: www.vekn.net/index.php/forum/9-event-reports-and-twd for inclusion in the Tournament Winning Deck Archive. Many amazing players will be missed because of the absence of those public results. This list celebrates those who have done well with the game, and have worked to publicize the strengths of the game by publishing their tournament winning deck lists. Players are listed by the number of tournaments that they have won, and if there is a tie for the number of tournament wins, then they are in alphabetical order by their first name. Players receive a star after their name for each national or continental champion title gained.

www.vekn.fr/hall_of_fame.htm

www.vekn.net/index.php/forum/9-event-reports-and-twd

www.vekn.fr/decks/twd.htm

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Deck Name: Giovanni Khazar diary *TWD* 10-10-15 Bochum Midnight tournament
Author: Jeroen van Oort
Description:
Result became 1st at a might multideck event with 10 players.
This is considerd a fun deck. O boy, what a fun event it was.

I have to point out that I was very, very lucky that game. I started with a perfect crypt: 4 diffrent vampires. Also a great starting hand: lots of masters and a parthenon. By turn 3 or 4 I played 2 liquidations, a parthenon, a jake washington, a kjazars diary, a ventrue acquired assets, an unmasking, ossian, milan, a repoman, a gregory winter and I think a sudario refraction.
The table situation was also ideal. Prey and predator with 0 intercept. A grand predator with an agressive rush deck to keep my predator busy and a grand prey to block all the bleeds from a ravnos bleed deck. It was all waiting for the Khazar to reach 7 counters. Then I took 3 more turns before hitting my prey full force with 8 to 10 khazar wraith minions. Once my prey and grand predator were dead this game became more exciting. My new prey martin couldn't win by ousting me, because he wouldn't have the stealth to do it, so he wanted my predator to oust me, or he wanted to get his 2nd vp near the 2 hour mark. My predator was highest seated, so only needed me to die and then survive till the 2 hour mark. Since I was second place seated, I could win by either timing out or hitting the 2 hour mark, but my predator was to weak to survive till that time.
My prey had at that time 6 or 7 minion. Carna, a few other decent tremeres and ponticulis. It took me quit a lot of bleed actions to get him to 0. I think about 25 to 30 bleed actions. Once he was dead my my predator shook hands with me.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Marius Iscru and Ruben Feldman leave the Hall of Fame for being suspended by the Ethic Commitee.

The Hall of Fame celebrates those who have done well with the game, but most importantly those who give a positive image of the game.

Their decks will still appear in the TWD though, as they can serve the community.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
